chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Fortifies Yan Mountain with Grand Formations – A Looming Tribulation
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning returns to Yan Mountain to layer his home with three legendary lethal formations, making it a fortress even Celestial Immortals can't breach. But an urgent message from his master changes everything.
og_title: Ji Ning Turns Yan Mountain Into an Unbreachable Fortress
og_description: The Bloodcloud Hall watches in frustration as Ji Ning and Uncle White build a formation web that traps even their spies. Then comes the news: his master's tribulation is in nine days.
twitter_title: Yan Mountain Becomes a Deadly Labyrinth
twitter_description: Ji Ning layers his home with formations so dense that even Celestial Immortals would be lost. But the real storm is yet to come—his master is about to face tribulation.

lore_anchors.definition: The oldest Loose Immortal of the Black-White College, known for his slovenly appearance. Here, he delivers the critical news of the Diancai Immortal’s impending tribulation.
A complex illusion-type formation that confuses and traps intruders, making them hopelessly lost. Its core is set around Serpentwing Lake.
A set of three legendary, exceptionally powerful defensive formations that Ji Ning plans to set up around Yan Mountain to guarantee its safety.
A formation that cannot be bypassed through cleverness or technique; it must be broken by raw, overwhelming force, requiring the strength of a True Immortal or Empyrean God.
A professional assassination organization operating across the Grand Xia world. They employ various methods—insects, merchant caravans, possession arts—for intelligence gathering.

A high-level spatial movement technique that allows a cultivator to instantly travel across vast distances, even between major worlds. Ji Ning uses this to return to Yan Mountain from the imperial capital.
